Name: Curly Hair Elliott
Author: FarmerBriar
Description:
Make Elliott into a curly-haired hobbit with this mod!

[size=4]SEASONAL HOBBIT ELLIOTT[/size]
This mod gently adjusts Elliott's sprites and portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] to have curly hair and slightly different outfits.

[size=4]CREDIT:[/size]
This mod uses Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic by  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] (See permissions for more info). The seasonal outfits mod is [b]required [/b]in order to use this one.

[size=4]DIRECTIONS:[/size]
1. To use this mod, you must have Slightly Cuter Seasonal Characters downloaded and set up properly with SMAPI and Content Patcher (see https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450). 
2. In the original mod folder, navigate to [ assets > characters > Elliott ] and copy over the Elliott files from the mod download file titled [characters]. 
3. Make sure you copy and replace the files, so only the new files are in your mod folder.  
4. Do the same for the Elliot Portraits, which will look something like this: [hobbit Elliott mod > portraits] *copy and replace to* [ assets > portraits > Elliott ]. 
5. Run the game with SMAPI, and the new portraits/sprites will appear in-game.

[size=4]NOTE: [/size]
Make sure you copy over the actual png. files instead of moving the folder.
